dialogues.jp: 音夢と一緒に帰るか。｛ゴール／家｝は一緒だし。
dialogues.en:
Shall I go with Nemu? We're heading to the same place
anyway.
dialogues.text:
Shall I go with Nemu? We're heading to the same place
anyway.

dialogues.jp: 「音夢」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんです？」

帰り支度をしていた音夢が俺を見上げる。周り
に人がいるときは、相変わらずの偽善者モード
だ。
dialogues.en:
She looked at me while packing up her stuff. She always
pretends innocence when there are people around us.
dialogues.text:
She looked at me while packing up her stuff. She always
pretends innocence when there are people around us.

dialogues.jp: 「一緒に帰るべ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？　用でもあるのか？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong? Do you have somewhere else to go?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong? Do you have somewhere else to go?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……いえ。じゃあ帰りましょうか」

一瞬、素の声をだした音夢が、ニッコリと微笑
みを浮かべ、席を立つ。
dialogues.en:
She sounded like her usual self for a second, and stood up
with a smile on her face.
dialogues.text:
She sounded like her usual self for a second, and stood up
with a smile on her face.

dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんだ？　さっきからニコニコして」
俺の隣を頬を緩ませて歩く音夢に声をかける。
dialogues.en: I asked her as she continued to smile.
dialogues.text: I asked her as she continued to smile.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「別に。普通だけど」
そう言いつつ、なんだか声が嬉しそうだが。
（まあ、いいけどな）

鼻歌を歌いだしそうな勢いの音夢を横にはべら
せ、来るときと同じに桜の花びらを全身に受け、
桜並木を歩いていく。
dialogues.en:
I headed home with Nemu walking next to me, with cherry
blossom petals blowing all over us again just like this
morning, she was in such a good mood.
dialogues.text:
I headed home with Nemu walking next to me, with cherry
blossom petals blowing all over us again just like this
morning, she was in such a good mood.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それにしても、今日はなんだか寒いね」
自分の肩を抱きしめるようにして、身体を擦る。
dialogues.en: She held her shoulders, and rubbed them to warm her self up.
dialogues.text: She held her shoulders, and rubbed them to warm her self up.

dialogues.jp: 「そうか？」
確かにまだ冬の｛はんちゅう／範疇｝だけど。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうです」

わざと｛す／拗｝ねたような顔で、音夢が今日の気温を
決定する。
dialogues.en: She decided that today was too cold for her.
dialogues.text: She decided that today was too cold for her.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うわぁ」
何もないところでつまずく。
dialogues.en: She staggered despite the flat surface.
dialogues.text: She staggered despite the flat surface.

dialogues.jp: 「おっと……」
音夢の背中に手を回して身体を支える。
dialogues.en: I supported her weight by holding her back with my arms.
dialogues.text: I supported her weight by holding her back with my arms.

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと浮かれすぎだぞ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もう……そんなんじゃないってば」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「？　おまえ、もしかして具合が悪いんじゃな
　いのか？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「えっ、そんなことないよ」

慌てて逃げ腰になる音夢の掴んだ腕を引っ張り、
顔を近づける。
dialogues.en: I pulled her arm to move my face closer to hers.
dialogues.text: I pulled her arm to move my face closer to hers.

dialogues.jp: ゴツッ

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はうっ」
音夢のおでこに自分の額をぶつけ、熱を測る。
dialogues.en: I put my forehead to hers to check her temperature.
dialogues.text: I put my forehead to hers to check her temperature.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、や、やめてよ兄さん……みんな見てる」
dialogues.en: "Hey, stop...... People are looking at us."
dialogues.text: "Hey, stop...... People are looking at us."

dialogues.jp: 顔の目の前で｛ささや／囁｝いた音夢の吐息が顔にかかる。
dialogues.en: I could feel her breath on my face.
dialogues.text: I could feel her breath on my face.

dialogues.jp:
キス寸前の俺たちの脇を、学生たちがチラチラ
と見ながら通り過ぎていく。
dialogues.en: The other students were staring at us almost kissing.
dialogues.text: The other students were staring at us almost kissing.

dialogues.jp:
か弱い拗ねた声をあげる音夢を無視して、俺は
カウントを続ける。
dialogues.en: I ignored her pleading, and kept counting.
dialogues.text: I ignored her pleading, and kept counting.

dialogues.jp: 「やっぱ、熱っぽいじゃないか」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そんな大したことないよ。いつもと同じだよ」
dialogues.en: "No, it's not. It's the same as usual."
dialogues.text: "No, it's not. It's the same as usual."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そのいつもが熱なんだろうが」

ったく――人に心配かけまいとひとりで頑張り
すぎだっての。
dialogues.en: Shit -- She's trying too hard to make me not worried.
dialogues.text: Shit -- She's trying too hard to make me not worried.

dialogues.jp: そっと肩を抱き、身を寄せる。
dialogues.en: I held her shoulder, and pulled her closer.
dialogues.text: I held her shoulder, and pulled her closer.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっ……兄さん、恥ずかしいよ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だったら、さっさと歩いて家に帰る」
音夢の肩を抱いたまま、そっと歩き出す。
dialogues.en: We began walking, I still held her shoulders.
dialogues.text: We began walking, I still held her shoulders.

dialogues.jp:
小さな溜め息を漏らしながらも、抵抗すること
なく音夢が歩を進める。
dialogues.en: She sighed, but didn't resist me and began walking.
dialogues.text: She sighed, but didn't resist me and began walking.

dialogues.jp:
「とりあえず、今日は俺が飯を用意するから、
　おまえは大人しく寝てろ」
dialogues.en: "You can rest while I prepare dinner."
dialogues.text: "You can rest while I prepare dinner."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おかゆが食べたいな……」

ぼそりと呟いた音夢の体重が、甘えるように俺
にかけられる。触れ合ったところから音夢の体
温が伝わり、心まで温まってくる。
dialogues.en:
She asked very quietly, and then leaned closer to me. I
could feel her heat where we were touching, and it warmed my
heart.
dialogues.text:
She asked very quietly, and then leaned closer to me. I
could feel her heat where we were touching, and it warmed my
heart.

dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、味の保証はしないが作ってやるよ」
dialogues.en: "I won't guarantee how good it'll taste."
dialogues.text: "I won't guarantee how good it'll taste."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ありがと、兄さん」
dialogues.en: I planned what to do next while supporting her weight.
dialogues.text: I planned what to do next while supporting her weight.

dialogues.jp:
俺は音夢の身体を支えながら、どんなおかゆを
作ろうか考えた。
◆具合の悪そうな音夢◆

音夢と一緒に家に帰る。まあ、目的地は一緒だ
しな……。
dialogues.en:
Head home with Nemu. We're heading to the same place
anyway......
dialogues.text:
Head home with Nemu. We're heading to the same place
anyway......

dialogues.jp:
途中、具合の悪そうな音夢に、例のやり方で体
温を測った。
dialogues.en:
On the way home, I checked her temperature by the usual
method.
dialogues.text:
On the way home, I checked her temperature by the usual
method.

dialogues.jp:
音夢曰く、『おかゆが食べたい』だと。どんな
おかゆを作ってやろうか……。
dialogues.en: She requested porridge for dinner. What a pain......
dialogues.text: She requested porridge for dinner. What a pain......
